epic_text:
Epic: Payment Refund System
As a customer, I want to request a refund so that I can get my money back.

AC1: Refund request within 30 days of purchase
AC2: Full or partial refund amount
AC3: Refund reason selection (dropdown)
AC4: Admin approval workflow (approve/reject with notes)
AC5: Automatic refund to original payment method
AC6: Refund status tracking (pending → approved → processed → completed)
prd_text: Refund system integrated with Stripe. Customers request refunds via self-service. Admins review and approve. Automatic processing via Stripe API.
architecture_text: FastAPI service with PostgreSQL. Stripe SDK for refund processing. State machine for refund status. Email notifications at each status change.
